name: shivai-rs
description: SHiVAi small vessel disease segmentation in the browser: Rust/WebAssembly pipeline, WebGPU networks, niimath registration, NiiVue display.

scripts.build: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:e2e: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node test/smoke.mjs
